results.fuzz: PASS after 30m1s with 8 workers: 4,516,384 executions, 369 new interesting inputs (1,574 in the corpus), no failing input; the target checks after each settled step that each ACTIVE fiber's activation reads the config of the last commit that a hand-off may carry, retained after the config it applied, that resolves, or else the config it applied

Medians of 16 interleaved rounds, ns per Enter+leave: 8 callers base 76.8 (45.0 to 84.7), head 80.6 (69.9 to 87.5); 32 callers base 76.8 (60.4 to 86.9), head 78.9 (69.1 to 87.0); the second batch alone gives 32 callers base 81.8 and head 79.5. Every round is 0 B/op and 0 allocs/op.
